---
name: Report a BGP incident
about: Tell us about a routing incident you saw, so we can test the detector on it
title: "Incident: <short description>"
labels: incident-report
---

Thank you! Every report becomes a test case for the detector. Approximate answers are fine.

**When did it happen?** (date, start and end time, with time zone)


**What happened?** (route leak, hijack, outage, worm, DDoS, misconfiguration, ...)


**Affected prefixes and/or ASes** (if you can share them)


**What did you see on your side?** (lost reachability, path changes, update storm, ...)


**Is there a public report?** (link to a mailing-list post, blog, status page, ...)


**May we contact you about it?** (yes / no; leave contact details only if you are comfortable with them being public)
